name: Cabinet
line: A natural-history cabinet in walnut and brass: the headline sits on a brass-framed drawer label, and as you scroll the drawer slides out to reveal a tray of six plate details; one Group 1 drawer holds 1,000 pins each for smokers and non-smokers, the four groups are a chest of drawers and the explorers two large drawers.
notes: Alegreya and Alegreya Sans cover Cyrillic. The wood grain is an inline SVG noise texture (no image file). The specimen details are cropped in CSS from the full plates. The pull-out runs on screens 861px and wider with motion allowed; on phones, without JavaScript or with reduced motion the drawer is shown open. Brass buttons use a lighter brass (#CDB384 to #D9C291) so their dark text passes AA.
